Unique Research · Company / Funding · June 20, 2022

On Jun 16, 2022, full-funnel intelligent marketing SaaS Lixiao Yun (励销云) (founded 2014) closed a multi-¥100M Series B+ led by Telstra Ventures, with Fortune Capital, 58 Shenqi, and returning Legend Capital — 7th round — for product, platform, and marketing. B2B digitalsales: acquire → screen → manage → digital warehouse → CS. 10k+ enterprise clients, millions of frontline sales, 1,000+ cities; H1’22 pandemic period rev doubled via direct+channel+CS model.
